title: 868. Walking Robot Simulation

examples.explanation: The robot walks to (0, 4), turns east, then walks to (3, 4), where 3*3 + 4*4 = 25.
The robot reaches (0, 4), is stopped by the obstacle at (2, 4) and halts at (1, 4), then turns north and finishes at (1, 8), giving 1 + 64 = 65.
The robot walks north to (0, 6), turns around, and walks back to the origin. The farthest point is (0, 6) with distance squared 36.
